upgrade.label: VoiceStudio
upgrade.scope: Signed APK identity/version/provider continuity and unchanged assets/runtime verified. No device installation, data-retention or functional acceptance performed.

nativeFlow: passed; native-flow-1.5.13.log; process exit 0; sockets disabled; authored ONNX graph

localResume.wavParity: complete WAV equals uninterrupted output, including automatic anchor RMS/codes
localResume.corruption: one damaged chunk recomputed; unchanged chunks reused; complete WAV equal
localResume.settingsChange: changed steps invalidate all chunk keys

cacheIdentity: text/language/speed/style/steps/seed/reference text+RMS+codes/tokenizer hash/model path+file metadata; small <=4MiB ONNX graph hash
cacheIntegrity: SHA256 envelope; full token shape/range; bounded 17000-byte entries; fsync/atomic replace; pending entries ignored
modelFingerprintLimit: large weights use file size/date, not per-resume full content SHA; replacing large weights while preserving size+mtime requires new task or old cache removal
cachePrivacy: per-job app-private directory; digest and acoustic tokens, no raw input text or credential; job deletion removes directory
cacheScope: only completed backbone tokens; final decode and saving still run; first generation is not accelerated by cache
releaseBackup: exact APK and unchanged key/password/alias instructions; private GitHub credential destination authorization pending
